content: Yesu mwawasega ꞌitoolo limana
Sabate mulinaya niꞌatu be tomwa ꞌiulisi wiki auwauna ꞌana ꞌasiyata nugana ꞌena, Meli Magidala ma ina waliyesa simai ꞌaliꞌaliya sabi ayausa.
Ta mwaniꞌiniꞌi sinabwana ꞌidedela, nate ꞌInapwana ꞌina anilose ꞌebweu galewega ꞌiebusima ga gulewa ꞌaliꞌali ꞌawanega ꞌipuli ilena ga ꞌena ꞌimiyatowa.
Anilose nina ꞌana ꞌita namala nadigega, ta ꞌana ꞌoama wakewakeke ꞌaiꞌailina.
Ta ꞌaliꞌali ꞌana toꞌitaꞌiꞌitao anilose siꞌitena ga simatauta sinabwana, ꞌenega sitai, ga sibeꞌu baleꞌuya kokowa ꞌatuwa.
Ta anilose nina iine nidi ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wamatamatauta. Yamwalamwalatoni ꞌomi Yesu tauna niꞌatu siloemwawasina waꞌebeꞌebese.
Tauna nigeya bada, manuna niꞌatu mwawasega ꞌitoolo limana, nadigega lowa ꞌieonemi. Wamai be ꞌina ꞌebeꞌeno kakaena waꞌita,
be muliyega watauya manini be ꞌina tononoyao waeonadi ꞌaene Yesu mwawasega niꞌatu ꞌitoolo limana, be ꞌiabe ꞌinuganugana Galili ꞌena, ta ꞌomi wamuliye be gote ꞌena waꞌita. Nate namo.”
ꞌEnega iine nidi ma idi matauta ta wate ma idi gwausowala ꞌaliꞌali sipilisinena ga sipili manini be ꞌaene Yesu ꞌina tononoyao ꞌediya yage gete sida simana.
Ta Yesu ꞌedaya ꞌilobedi ga ꞌilokagutokiyedi, ta simai ga ꞌaena sigitoodi ta sibwagobwago ꞌenaya.
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wamatamatauta, ta esi watauya be gosegwao waemataluwedi be sitatauya Galili ꞌena, be nada sida ꞌitagu.”
Toꞌitaꞌiꞌitao ꞌidi simana
Iine nidi maꞌetamo ꞌedaya sitautauya ta ꞌaliꞌali ꞌana toꞌitaꞌiꞌitao ꞌaidi sitauya ꞌasa Yelusalema ꞌenaya, ga toꞌase siapwesa nadigega sisimanena totaliyao sinabwadi ꞌediya.
ꞌEnega totaliyao nidi ta ꞌinapwanao maꞌediyao sideli egogona ga siloina, ga mani toꞌitaꞌiꞌitao nidi siꞌebwaꞌedi
be ꞌaene tomota ꞌediya sida simana dadana be ꞌaene sida gwae, “Boiboiya ꞌaꞌenoꞌeno ta Yesu ꞌina tononoyao simai ga kokowana siꞌipwalina.”
Wate sieonedi, sigwae, “ꞌEguma toloina sinabwana ale gete ꞌinonoi ꞌetamo ꞌakaboe be ꞌenega geyaꞌabo ꞌigamwagamwasowala ꞌemiya.”
ꞌEnega ꞌidi mani siꞌewena ga totaliyao be ꞌinapwanao ꞌidi nuwanuwa nina siematamatanena. Ta ꞌidi emwasala gete ꞌiꞌelelewana me Yudia ꞌediya, ga batuwa wate nadigega sionaona.
Yesu ꞌina tononoyao ꞌidi paisewa ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌina tononoyao site ilebeni sitauya Galili ga situꞌe ꞌoya nina Yesu ꞌisimanena ꞌenaya,
ga Yesu siꞌitena ga ꞌena sibwagobwago. Ta ꞌaidi ꞌediyega ꞌetamo ma idi enuwanaluwa.
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌimai ꞌediya ta ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Tamagu loina maiboꞌana galewaya ta baleꞌuya niꞌatu ꞌiꞌebwaꞌegu.

ꞌEnega watatauya be sena maiboꞌadi ꞌediya waloguguya, be ꞌenega tomota sida emisegu, be wate wagiebapitaisoedi Tamagu ꞌana esanega be Natuna ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌagu esanega be wate Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌana esanega.
Ta loina maiboꞌana niꞌatu yaꞌebwaꞌemi waeꞌitadi be taudi wate sida muliyedi. Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌaboꞌagu maꞌemiya yada miyami tuta yauyauna, batuwa ga ꞌana laba baleꞌu ꞌana ꞌebe losalowa ꞌenaya.”
